description: This file is a shell script library ('git-mergetool--lib') designed for sourcing by other shell scripts to facilitate Git merge tool operations. It defines functions related to determining and invoking merge tools within the Git environment.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Returns a merge tool; sets return code to 1 if a guess was made, else 0. Checks for GIT_MERGETOOL_GUI to select appropriate GUI tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Returns the custom command line for executing a specified merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Provides the path to the merge tool executable.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Sets up functions specific to the merge tool, making them ready for use or override.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Launches a merge tool based on provided name and a flag indicating presence of a merge base. Uses environment variables MERGED, LOCAL, REMOTE, and BASE.
